harking_note: Alle parameters vastgelegd vóór data-inspectie op H1 overlap breakout data.
note: London/NY overlap H1 continuation breakout — true pre-registration locked before first QuantBuild engine run (EXP-003). Engine implementation follows in QuantBuild; data layer H1 + 5 symbols available via parquet cache.
mechanistic_basis: London/NY overlap (13:30–16:00 UTC) is the most liquid daily window. The first H1 candle after 13:30 UTC absorbs initial order flow from both sessions. A close outside that range on the next H1 candle signals that dominant order flow has chosen a direction — continuation is the expected outcome, not reversal. Distinct from HYP-002 (reversal after sweep).
null_hypothesis_H0: A close outside the first H1 candle range after 13:30 UTC does not generate positive expected value on the five specified instruments over a 5-year window. Formally: expectancy_r ≤ 0 and ci_95_lower < 0.028 (combined and per gate definitions below).
alternative_hypothesis_H1: A close outside that range generates positive expected value visible in ci_95_lower ≥ 0.028 AND profit_factor ≥ 1.5 over the full 5-year window on the combined dataset (dual economic gate).

setup_definition.range_candle: First full H1 candle with open >= 13:30:00 UTC (calendar day)
setup_definition.breakout_long: close of next H1 candle > range_high (strict)
setup_definition.breakout_short: close of next H1 candle < range_low (strict)
setup_definition.entry: open of the H1 candle after the breakout candle
setup_definition.filters: London/NY overlap session days only; skip entries on major news days (NFP, FOMC, CPI) via boolean in config
setup_definition.ambiguity_rule: One entry per instrument per day; if both directions break same calendar day — no entry (skip)

reject_if: OR more than 3 of 5 instruments individually economic FAIL
validation_required_if: combined PASS but fewer than 3 instruments individually PASS

test_plan_summary: Per instrument and combined: inferential layer aligned with suite — Wilcoxon signed-rank vs 0 where applicable; bootstrap 95% CI on mean R with seed 42 and 10k iterations; Cohen d / effect interpretation as in inference_v1; dual gate ci_95_lower vs 0.028 and profit_factor vs 1.5. Requires per-trade R series from QuantBuild/QuantLog after london_ny_overlap_breakout engine exists.
